method: Secondary desk research; no participant study

sources.title: How to use Netflix on your hotel TV
sources.verification: Opened and relevant page content reviewed
sources.finding: For the described supported hotel offering, information clears at checkout and manual sign-out is available.
sources.scope: Selected hotel integrations; not every TV or rental.
sources.design_inference: D1: do not label recorded accounts as verified active or signed out.

sources.title: See devices with account access
sources.verification: Opened and relevant page content reviewed
sections: Sign out on a device you no longer use
sources.finding: Device/session review and sign-out are available; session names and activity require interpretation.
sources.design_inference: D2: provider-specific guidance, not universal session detection.

sources.title: Cyber security when travelling overseas
sources.verification: Opened and relevant page content reviewed
sources.finding: Sign out after use, avoid remembered logins and avoid sensitive personal logins on shared computers.
sources.scope: Broad overseas-travel advice, not evidence of app effectiveness.
sources.design_inference: D3: preventive manual review without service-password collection.

excluded_sources.result: Open attempt returned HTTP 403; not used to satisfy the three-source requirement.
